answer: The 3-qubit GHZ circuit ran on sirius:mock with 200 shots. The circuit was H on q0, CNOT 0 to 1, CNOT 1 to 2, then a measurement of all 3 qubits. I built it in Qiskit and used the IQM backend's transpile, which adds the MOVE gates that Sirius needs. Job 01a15fa0-22da-7199-891b-29fe6846d3bd finished with success=True. The counts were {"000": 200}. A mock backend does not simulate real quantum behavior, so these counts do not show the even mix of 000 and 111 that a GHZ state would give on real hardware. The script is at /Users/claytonchancey/Desktop/quantum/.claude/worktrees/wf_3612af23-e49-43/run_ghz.py.
